source.title: Results and open problems on Hamiltonian labelings of graphs

trace.notes: Normalized one URL source: https://zbmath.org/5778154. Direct shell fetch of the zbMATH page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the page itself was classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Identifier-specific recovery through the zbMATH Open API succeeded for document id 5778154. Metadata identified the exact work as Okamoto, Renzema, and Zhang, "Results and open problems on Hamiltonian labelings of graphs," Congr. Numer. 198, 189-206 (2009), Zbl 1206.05087, but provided no full-text links.

The Combinatorial Press volume page for Congressus Numerantium 198 contains only the bibliographic listing for the same article and does not expose the article body, PDF, or problem statements. It was treated as metadata_only for extraction.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempts used exact title plus PDF, exact title alone, MR2584352, Zbl 1206.05087, the authors' names, Crossref title search, OpenAlex title search, and DBLP title search. Candidate results were rejected because they were references to the target, metadata-only resolver pages, a different paper titled "Hamiltonian labelings of graphs," or unrelated works.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. The source adequacy gate therefore prevents extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, search snippets, Combinatorial Press volume metadata, or references in related papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5778154.json and outputs/latest.json.
